heading: INT. SHARK TUNNEL - CLOSED AQUARIUM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SHARK TUNNEL - CLOSED AQUARIUM - NIGHT
A glass tube through a vast dark tank.
Sharks slide overhead like slow thoughts.
Blue light ripples on the floor.
VIVEK SHARMA (40s, crew leader, wetsuit under a janitor's coverall) crouches at a service panel with a flashlight in his teeth.
LORNA BISHOP (30s, safecracker, headset, earring) leans on the rail, studying a tablet.
BAPTISTE LAROCHE (50s, driver, cardigan) watches the sharks with real concern.
SUNNY OKAFOR (20s, rookie, backpack of gear) stands frozen near the exit.
Come on, come on.
units.name: VIVEK

units.text: Sunny, the east door.
units.name: LORNA

units.text: Which one's east?
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: The one with the hammerhead.
units.name: BAPTISTE

units.text: They all have a hammerhead!
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Vivek, thirty seconds on the guard.
units.name: LORNA

units.text: I know.
units.name: VIVEK

units.text: That one is looking at me.
units.name: BAPTISTE

units.text: Sharks don't look.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: That one does.
units.name: BAPTISTE

units.text: Everybody, listen. Panel opens in five, four--
units.name: LORNA

units.text: Three--
units.name: VIVEK

units.text: Wait, wait, which door--
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Left! The left one!
units.name: BAPTISTE

units.text: The panel pops.
Vivek pulls out a thin steel case and snaps it shut.
Lorna is already running.
Sunny sprints after her, backpack bouncing.
The alarm begins to whoop.
The sharks scatter, a gray bloom in blue.
I told them. I told them about the sharks.
units.name: BAPTISTE
